_about: Where to read more. Anything under copyright is linked, not copied. 'In the app' means a public-domain text already in the library.

entries.title: Catechism of the Catholic Church, nn. 115-119 and 128-130
entries.author: The Church
entries.note: The senses of Scripture and the meaning of typology, in a few short numbers.

entries.title: Dei Verbum (Vatican II, 1965), nn. 12-16
entries.author: Second Vatican Council
entries.note: How to read the Bible as the Word of God in human words, and how the two Testaments belong together (n. 16).

entries.title: The Demonstration of the Apostolic Preaching
entries.author: Irenaeus of Lyons (trans. J. A. Robinson, 1920)
entries.note: A short proof, c. 190, that the prophets point to Christ. Public domain, in the library.

entries.title: Life and Times of Jesus the Messiah, Appendix IX
entries.author: Alfred Edersheim (1883)
entries.note: A list of the Old Testament passages the ancient synagogue applied to the Messiah, with the rabbinic sources. A Protestant scholar writing in the 19th century: read for the Jewish background. Public domain, in the library.

entries.title: The Temple: Its Ministry and Services
entries.author: Alfred Edersheim (1874)
entries.note: The Passover, the Day of Atonement and the daily sacrifice as they were practised in Jesus' day. Public domain, in the library.

entries.title: Cyprian, Three Books of Testimonies Against the Jews
entries.author: Cyprian of Carthage
entries.note: A third-century catalogue of Old Testament texts grouped under the claims they support (the Stone, the Lamb, the sign of the cross). Public domain, in the library.

entries.title: From Shadows to Reality: Studies in the Biblical Typology of the Fathers
entries.author: Jean Daniélou, S.J. (English translation 1960)
entries.note: The classic study of how the Fathers read types of baptism, the Eucharist and the Church.

entries.title: Jesus and the Jewish Roots of the Eucharist
entries.author: Brant Pitre
entries.note: Pitre's argument that the manna, the bread of the Presence and the Passover shape what Jesus does at the Last Supper.

entries.title: The Old Testament: A Historical and Theological Journey Through Jewish Scripture
entries.author: Brant Pitre (Catholic Productions)
entries.note: Includes a section on typology and messianic prophecy, and the seven covenants.

entries.title: Brant Pitre's website
entries.author: Brant Pitre
entries.note: Books, talks and background on his Jewish-roots approach.

entries.title: A Father Who Keeps His Promises: God's Covenant Love in Scripture
entries.author: Scott Hahn (Servant Books, 1998)
entries.note: The covenants of Scripture, from Adam to Christ, as one story.

entries.title: Biblical typology (interview)
entries.author: Five Books for Catholics
entries.note: A conversation that recommends further reading on typology and starts from Augustine's principle.
